knimeNode.name: Population Migration
knimeNode.shortDescription: Exchanges strong candidates between populations in one combined table.

fullDescription.intro: Groups rows automatically by their IdeaFlow population identity and exchanges the strongest feasible candidates at the configured generation interval using ring, reproducible-random, or all-to-all routing. Incoming candidates can replace the weakest destination candidates or be added. Migrants retain their evaluated decision and objective values while destination-local optimizer memory remains isolated.

ports.inPort: At least two population IDs per run, normally produced by Concatenate.
ports.outPort: One combined table ready for the shared loop end or population filters.
